_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles. These render at about 74px, so every prompt asks for one bold centered object with a simple silhouette and no fine detail. Subjects are static objects or one simple contact, per the rule in CLAUDE.md: convergence, immersion, enclosure and internal engagement all come back wrong. Silhouettes are deliberately kept far apart from each other — a tall thin column, a sphere on legs, a boxy fan bank, a cone of gravel, a stack of log ends, a tree, and a horizontal pipe on cradles — so no two tiles read the same at thumbnail size. Nothing here is a cutaway and nothing is a process flow.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red, yellow or green anywhere, even where the real object would be that color. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: A single tall slender industrial absorber column standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a plain cylindrical tower roughly six times as tall as it is wide, with a domed top, a short inlet nozzle low on one side, a short outlet nozzle at the very top, and two flat ring flanges around the middle of the shell. It stands on a simple skirt base. Exterior view only, not a cutaway. Tall and narrow is the whole point of the silhouette. No other equipment, no piping runs, no platforms, no ladders.
partPrompts.2: A single spherical pressure vessel standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: one large smooth sphere supported clear of the ground on four straight slanted legs, with a short vertical stub nozzle on top and a small flange at the base of the sphere. Exterior view only. The ball-on-legs silhouette is the whole point: perfectly round, no other shapes, no columns, no tanks, no piping, no railings.
partPrompts.3: A direct air capture collector module standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: one shipping-container-shaped box, wider than it is tall, whose entire front face is taken up by three large circular fan openings in a row, each with a simple ring rim and straight radial blades. Low feet under the box. Exterior view only, not a cutaway. Bold rectangle with three bold circles on it, nothing else: no ducts, no stacks, no piping, no stacking of multiple boxes.
partPrompts.4: A cone-shaped pile of crushed rock sitting alone on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: one broad low conical heap with a slightly irregular surface texture suggesting coarse gravel, and two angular chunks of rock lying separately on the ground beside it with clear space between them and the pile. One heap and two loose rocks, nothing else: no machinery, no conveyor, no truck, no bags.
partPrompts.5: A stack of cut logs resting on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: about seven or eight straight round logs of similar diameter stacked in a tidy pyramid, four along the bottom and fewer above, with the sawn circular end faces of the near row facing the viewer and their growth rings drawn as a few simple concentric circles. All logs lie horizontally and parallel. Just the stack, no ground detail, no trees, no machinery, no straps.
partPrompts.6: A single broadleaf tree standing on a rectangular block of soil, seen three-quarter: a straight trunk with a few branches and a simple rounded leafy crown, growing from a clean-edged cuboid of earth cut like a display sample, with a spread of roots drawn as a few simple tapering lines inside the block. One tree on one block, centered, with clear background. No forest, no other plants, no fence, no buildings, no sky detail.
partPrompts.7: A short section of large-diameter pipeline lying horizontally on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: one straight thick cylinder resting in two curved cradle saddles that sit on low rectangular plinths, with a raised bolted ring flange closing the near end of the pipe and a plain open cut at the far end. Exterior view only. One pipe and two saddles, nothing else: no valves, no other pipes, no trench, no vehicles.
